explanation: The main character in the Book of Job, a righteous man who undergoes great trials and suffering.
Tests or challenges intended to strengthen faith and character.
Pain, distress, or discomfort experienced by an individual.
An evil spiritual being who opposes God and tempts people to sin.
God's acceptance or consent for something to happen, even if it may be painful or difficult.
Acting in a morally correct way and in accordance with God's will.
Expressing dissatisfaction, grief, or suffering, often directed toward God.
Three individuals who visit Job to comfort him but end up accusing him of having sinned.
The ability to use knowledge and experience effectively and wisely.
God's response to Job's complaints, in which He highlights His own power and wisdom.
